Customer question: I placed an order but did not receive a confirmation email. What should I do?
Answer: An order confirmation is sent to the email address entered at checkout. Check your spam folder and allow up to 15 minutes. If you saved the order number shown after checkout, use Order Lookup with that number and the checkout email. If you still cannot locate the order, contact support before placing it again so we can help you avoid a duplicate order.

Customer question: Can I cancel my order?
Answer: You can cancel from Order Lookup or your account within 30 minutes of placing the order, provided it has not entered packing. Select Manage Order and then Cancel Order. If the button is no longer available, cancellation is no longer possible. After delivery, eligible items can be returned within 30 days of delivery.

Customer question: I entered the wrong shipping address. Can I change it?
Answer: Open Order Lookup and select Manage Order within 30 minutes of placing the order. You can change the shipping address only while the order has not entered packing. If the address cannot be edited, contact support promptly. A change cannot be guaranteed once packing starts, and we cannot redirect a parcel after dispatch.

Topic: Change an item or size before shipping
Customer question: Can I change the size, color, or items in an order I just placed?
Answer: Items, sizes, and colors cannot be edited after an order is placed. If the order is less than 30 minutes old and has not entered packing, cancel it through Manage Order and place a new order with the correct items. If it is already being packed, keep the order and request an eligible return or exchange after delivery.

Customer question: I forgot to use my discount code. Can you add it to my order?
Answer: A promotion code cannot be added after checkout. If your order is still within the 30-minute cancellation window and has not entered packing, you can cancel and place it again using the code. Otherwise, the price paid remains unchanged. Promotions cannot be combined, and final-sale items and gift cards are excluded from promotion codes.

Customer question: Why did only part of my order arrive?
Answer: Items in one order may be sent from different warehouses and arrive in separate parcels. Check the shipping confirmation for a tracking link for each parcel. You pay the shipping charge shown at checkout only once; there is no extra shipping fee for a split shipment. Contact support if an item listed on a packing slip is missing from that parcel, or all listed parcels have arrived and an item is still missing.

Customer question: When will my preorder ship, and will it delay my other items?
Answer: A preorder's estimated dispatch date appears on the product page and in your order confirmation. In-stock items ship separately without waiting for the preorder, at no additional standard shipping charge. Preorder items use standard shipping and are not eligible for express delivery. We email you if the estimated dispatch date changes.

Customer question: Where do you deliver?
Answer: We deliver to residential and business street addresses in the 48 contiguous United States. We do not currently deliver to Alaska, Hawaii, US territories, military addresses, PO boxes, or international addresses. Available shipping options are shown after you enter your delivery address at checkout.

Customer question: How much is standard shipping, and when is it free?
Answer: Standard shipping costs $5.95. It is free when the merchandise subtotal is at least $75 after discounts and before tax. Gift card purchases do not count toward the $75 threshold. The shipping charge confirmed at checkout is not increased later if you return part of the order.

Customer question: How long does standard delivery take?
Answer: In-stock standard orders normally leave our warehouse within 1 to 2 business days. Standard transit then takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding US public holidays. The dispatch confirmation includes your tracking link and the carrier's estimated delivery date.

Customer question: How does express shipping work?
Answer: Express shipping costs $14.95, including on orders that qualify for free standard shipping. In-stock express orders placed before 2 PM Eastern Time on a business day are normally dispatched that day; later orders are normally dispatched the next business day. Express transit takes 2 business days after dispatch. Preorder items are not eligible for express delivery.

Customer question: Where can I find my tracking number?
Answer: Your dispatch email contains a tracking link for each parcel. You can also open the order in your account or Order Lookup and select Track Parcel. Tracking may take up to 24 hours after dispatch to show the carrier's first scan.

Customer question: My tracking link has not updated. Is the parcel lost?
Answer: Allow up to 24 hours after dispatch for the first carrier scan. If tracking stops updating while the parcel is in transit, check the carrier's estimated delivery date. Contact support if there has been no new scan for 3 business days or the parcel is past the carrier's estimated delivery date. We will investigate with the carrier.

Customer question: Tracking says delivered, but I cannot find my order. What should I do?
Answer: Check the delivery photo, your entrance or mailroom, and anyone who may have accepted the parcel. Sometimes a delivery scan appears before the parcel is physically dropped off, so allow 24 hours. If it is still missing, contact support with your order number and confirm the delivery address so we can investigate with the carrier.

Customer question: I missed a delivery attempt. How can I get my parcel?
Answer: Use the carrier's tracking page to check the next delivery attempt or available pickup options. Bring the identification requested by the carrier when collecting a parcel. If the parcel is being returned to us, contact support so we can discuss a new shipment or an eligible refund.

Customer question: My order was returned to sender. What happens next?
Answer: Contact support with your order number and the correct delivery address. Once the parcel returns to our warehouse, we can arrange a new standard shipment or refund the eligible merchandise. A new $5.95 shipping charge applies when the original address was incomplete or incorrect. If the return was caused by our error or the carrier's error, the replacement shipment is free.

Customer question: My express order is late. Can the express shipping charge be refunded?
Answer: Contact support with your order number if an express parcel arrives after the carrier's confirmed delivery commitment. We will review the tracking record and the reason for the delay. If we approve a refund of the express shipping charge, we send it to the original payment method; your bank may take an additional 3 to 5 business days to display it.

Customer question: Can I return an item that does not fit or that I no longer want?
Answer: Start a return within 30 calendar days of delivery. Items must be unused, unwashed, and in their original condition with tags attached. Trying clothing on indoors is fine, but items with wear, stains, odors, or alterations are not eligible for a change-of-mind return. Final-sale items and delivered digital gift cards have separate restrictions.

Customer question: How do I start a return?
Answer: Open Returns and Exchanges on our website and enter your order number and the email address used at checkout. Select the items and choose a refund or an available size or color exchange. If the items are eligible, we email a prepaid USPS label and a QR code. Send the approved items within 14 calendar days of the label being issued.

Customer question: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
Answer: For an ordinary refund return, $6 is deducted from your refund for each prepaid return label used. You can place all approved items covered by the same label in one parcel, so the fee is per parcel rather than per item. Eligible size or color exchanges use a free return label. We also cover return shipping when we sent a wrong, damaged, or defective item.

Customer question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
Answer: Within 30 calendar days of delivery, you can request a different available size or color of the same product through Returns and Exchanges. The original item must be unused and unwashed with tags attached. The return label and standard shipping for the replacement are free. To receive a different product, return the original for a refund and place a new order.

Customer question: Is my replacement item reserved when I request an exchange?
Answer: Replacement stock is not reserved when an exchange is requested. We confirm availability after the original item arrives and passes inspection. If the requested size or color has sold out, support will offer another available option or a refund to the original payment method. We do not deduct a return label fee if we cannot fulfill an approved exchange.

Customer question: When will my replacement size be sent?
Answer: We inspect an exchange return and normally dispatch the available replacement within 3 business days after it reaches our warehouse. The replacement then travels by standard shipping, normally 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. We email a new tracking link. If you need an item sooner, placing a separate order is the faster option, subject to stock availability.

Customer question: Can I return or exchange an item marked Final Sale?
Answer: Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged for a change of mind or a different size. This restriction is shown on the product page and at checkout. If we sent the wrong item or it arrived damaged, report it within 7 calendar days of delivery. Suspected manufacturing defects must be reported to support within 90 calendar days of delivery for review.

Customer question: I received the wrong item or an item arrived damaged. How do you fix it?
Answer: Contact support within 7 calendar days of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item, its label, and any damaged packaging. Do not pay for a return label yourself. Once we verify the problem, we arrange a replacement or refund and cover any required return shipping. This also applies to final-sale items.

Customer question: A seam or fastening failed after I received the item. Can you help?
Answer: Report a suspected manufacturing defect within 90 calendar days of delivery with your order number and photos. We review the issue and, if it is a manufacturing defect, offer a replacement or refund and cover any required return shipping. Normal wear, accidental damage, and damage caused by ignoring the care label are not covered. Eligible manufacturing defects on final-sale items are included.

Customer question: I received an item as a gift. Can I return or exchange it?
Answer: A gift item follows the same 30-day return window and condition requirements as a regular purchase. Use the gift receipt or ask support to locate the order. You can exchange for an available size or color of the same product, or receive a digital gift card for the amount originally paid. A gift return does not refund the purchaser's card. The ordinary $6 return label fee applies to a gift-card refund; eligible exchanges are free.

Customer question: Can I send a return if I do not have a printer?
Answer: Yes. The approval email includes a USPS QR code as well as a printable label. Pack the approved items, take the parcel and QR code to a participating USPS counter, and ask the clerk to print the label. Keep the drop-off receipt. Contact support if the email or QR code is missing.

Customer question: My return was approved near the end of the return window. When must I send it?
Answer: You must start the request within 30 calendar days of delivery. Once the return is approved, you have 14 calendar days from label issue to hand the parcel to USPS, even if the original 30-day window ends during that period. If the label expires before you send it, contact support before using it; a new label is not automatic.

Customer question: When will I receive my refund after returning an item?
Answer: We inspect a refund return and issue an approved refund within 5 business days after the parcel reaches our warehouse. We email you when it is issued. Your bank or card provider may then take an additional 3 to 5 business days to show the credit. The return parcel's delivery scan starts the warehouse processing period, not the bank's posting period.

Customer question: How can I check whether my return has been refunded?
Answer: Use the return tracking link to confirm warehouse delivery, then look for a refund confirmation email. Allow up to 5 business days after warehouse delivery for inspection and approval. If you received the refund email but cannot see the credit, allow the bank an additional 3 to 5 business days. Contact support when the applicable period has passed.

Customer question: Why is my refund smaller than the item's original price?
Answer: A refund is based on the price actually paid for the returned item, including its share of any order-level discount and the applicable tax. An ordinary prepaid refund return has a $6 fee per label used. Original outbound shipping is not refunded for a change-of-mind return. We do not add a new outbound shipping charge if the remaining items fall below the free-shipping threshold.

Customer question: Can my refund be sent to a different card?
Answer: Refunds go to the original payment method and cannot be moved to a different card or bank account. If the original card has expired or been replaced, the card issuer normally routes the credit to the replacement account. Contact your card issuer if you need help locating it. Gift-recipient returns are issued as a digital gift card instead.

Customer question: I paid with a gift card and a credit card. Where will the refund go?
Answer: For an ordinary purchaser return, the approved refund goes back to the gift card first, up to the gift card amount used on the order. Any remaining approved refund goes to the original card. Neither payment method receives more than the amount it originally paid. The refund confirmation shows the allocation.

Customer question: My return tracking has stopped. Will I still get a refund?
Answer: If you used our prepaid label, keep your USPS drop-off receipt and contact support when there has been no return tracking update for 5 business days. We will open a carrier investigation and review the proof of drop-off. A refund is not automatic while the parcel is missing. If you arranged your own shipping, contact that carrier and share the tracking details with us.

Customer question: What happens if an item does not pass return inspection?
Answer: We email you with the reason and any relevant photos if an item is worn, washed, missing required tags, or otherwise outside the approved return conditions. Support will explain the available next steps before the case is closed. An inspection rejection does not automatically create a refund, and items are not automatically discarded without contacting you.

Customer question: Which payment methods can I use?
Answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and our digital gift cards. Available methods appear at checkout. All prices and payments are in US dollars. You can combine a digital gift card with one supported card or wallet payment to cover the remaining balance.

Customer question: Why is there a pending charge before my order ships?
Answer: A card authorization is placed when you order, and the card payment is collected when the items dispatch. Gift card funds are deducted at checkout. A pending authorization is not an extra completed charge. A split shipment can produce separate completed charges that add up to the order total; you are not charged the full total again for each parcel.

Customer question: My payment was declined, but my bank shows a pending amount. Was I charged?
Answer: A declined checkout may leave a temporary authorization even though no order was completed. Check for an order confirmation before trying again. Your bank normally removes an unused authorization within 3 to 5 business days, although its timing can vary. If you have an order number or see two completed charges, contact support so we can check the order.

Customer question: Why is my promotion code not working?
Answer: Use one promotion code per order and enter it before paying. Check its expiry date, minimum spend, and eligible items. Codes do not apply to final-sale items, gift cards, shipping, or tax, and they cannot be combined. The checkout message explains why a code is not eligible. Free standard shipping still uses the merchandise subtotal after discounts.

Customer question: How do I buy and use a digital gift card?
Answer: Digital gift cards are emailed to the recipient address entered at purchase after payment is approved, normally within 15 minutes. Enter the gift card code at checkout to use all or part of the balance. Our gift cards do not expire, and any unused balance stays on the same code. Delivered digital gift cards cannot be returned for a change of mind.

Customer question: The digital gift card email is missing. Can you resend it?
Answer: Check the recipient's spam folder and allow up to 15 minutes after payment approval. If it is still missing, contact support with the gift card order number and the purchaser's checkout email. After verifying the purchase, we can resend it or correct the recipient email. Do not post an unused gift card code in a public chat or review.

Customer question: An item I bought is now on sale. Can I receive the difference?
Answer: If a full-price item drops to a regular sale price within 7 calendar days of your order date, contact support with the order number. We offer one price adjustment per item to the original payment method. This does not apply to final-sale purchases, promotion codes, flash promotions, or gift cards. After approval, a card credit may take an additional 3 to 5 business days to appear.

Customer question: How do I choose the right clothing size?
Answer: Open the Size Guide on the individual product page and compare your body measurements with that item's chart. Most core clothing styles are available from XS to 3XL, but the product's available options are the final guide. Check the fit notes and model measurements as well. Size charts can differ between products, so do not rely only on a size bought in another style.

Customer question: I am between sizes. Which size should I choose?
Answer: Use the product's fit notes to decide: a fitted cut usually feels closer to the body than a relaxed cut. If you prefer extra room, choose the larger of the two sizes unless the product page says otherwise. Support can compare the garment measurements with your preferred fit. An eligible unused item can be exchanged for another available size within 30 days of delivery.

Customer question: Do you offer petite or tall sizes?
Answer: Selected trousers and dresses have petite or tall length options. Available lengths and inseam measurements appear on the individual product page. If a length is not listed, that version is not currently offered for the style. Support can help compare measurements, but we do not provide a tailoring or alteration service.

Customer question: How should I wash and care for my clothing?
Answer: Follow the care label attached to the specific garment; it takes priority over general care advice. The product page also lists fabric composition and care details. If the label and product page appear to disagree, contact support with the style name and a photo of the label before washing. Damage caused by ignoring the care label is not treated as a manufacturing defect.

Customer question: Will an out-of-stock size be available again?
Answer: Select the unavailable size on the product page and use Notify Me if that option is offered. We email you when that exact size and color is available again. A notification does not reserve stock or guarantee a restock date. Limited collections and final-sale items may not be restocked.

Customer question: Will the color look exactly like the photos?
Answer: We photograph items to represent their color as closely as possible, but screen settings and lighting can make colors look different. Check the written color name and product photos together. An eligible unused item can be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery if the color is not what you expected. If the item label shows a different color from the one ordered, contact support as a wrong-item issue.

Customer question: Can you add a gift message and hide the price?
Answer: You can add a gift message during checkout at no charge. Clothing is folded in tissue inside our normal protective packaging; a separate gift box is not offered. The parcel's packing slip does not show prices, while the purchaser receives the payment receipt by email. A gift receipt can be included for eligible gift returns and exchanges.

Customer question: I checked out as a guest. How do I view my order?
Answer: You do not need an account to place or manage an order. Open Order Lookup and use your order number and the email entered at checkout. From there you can check status, track parcels, and access any cancellation or address-change options still available. Returns and Exchanges also accepts guest orders.

Customer question: I forgot my password. How can I sign in?
Answer: Choose Forgot Password on the sign-in page and enter the email address on your account. The reset link is valid for 1 hour. If it does not arrive, check spam and confirm the spelling of the email. Requesting a new link replaces the previous one. Support will never ask you to send your password.

Customer question: Can I change the email address on my account?
Answer: Sign in, open Account Settings, and enter the new email address. Confirm the change using the verification message sent to the new address. Updating an account email does not change the email already attached to an existing order. Contact support if an order's contact email also needs to be corrected.

Customer question: Why can I find an order in my email but not in my account?
Answer: An order may have been placed as a guest or with another email address. Use Order Lookup with the email and order number from the confirmation to access it. Contact support if you want help linking a verified guest order to your account. Creating a new account does not automatically import orders placed with a different email.

Customer question: Where can I download a receipt or invoice?
Answer: Open the order in your account or Order Lookup and select Download Receipt. The receipt shows purchased items, discounts, tax, shipping, and the amount paid in US dollars. Dispatches and approved refunds are also listed when applicable. Contact support if the billing name on the document needs a correction.

Customer question: How do I stop marketing emails without missing order updates?
Answer: Use Unsubscribe at the bottom of a marketing email or update Email Preferences in your account. It can take up to 2 business days for the change to apply. Order confirmations, dispatch messages, return instructions, and refund updates are still sent because they are needed to manage a purchase.

Customer question: What is the best way to contact customer support?
Answer: Use the website's live chat during support hours or email help@demo-apparel.example. For an existing order, include the order number, checkout email, and a short explanation of what happened. Add photos for a wrong, damaged, or defective item. Do not send your password, full card number, or card security code.

Customer question: When is your support team available, and how quickly do you reply?
Answer: Our team is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern Time, excluding US public holidays. We normally reply to email within 1 business day. Messages received outside support hours are handled on the next business day. Shipping transit estimates and return or refund processing periods use the same Monday-to-Friday business-day definition.

Topic: Follow up on a support request
Customer question: I already contacted support. Should I open another request?
Answer: Reply to the existing email conversation or quote the case number in live chat so the team can see the earlier details. Avoid opening several tickets for the same order because it can split the information between cases. Tell us promptly if the situation changes, such as a missing parcel arriving or a refund appearing in your bank account.

Customer question: I cannot use the return portal or online forms. Can someone help me?
Answer: Email help@demo-apparel.example or ask in live chat during support hours. We can help locate an order, explain the options in plain text, or create an eligible return or exchange request on your behalf after verifying the order. The same return deadlines and item conditions apply; contact us before the relevant deadline if you need assistance.
